title: Revenge Complete
summary: A flashback shows Lin Yi, the Heavenly Tower envoy, gathering Zhao's Nascent Soul masters to launch a god-making plan: rip out the spiritual roots of every mortal in Zhao to feed one talent to Soul Formation and lift Zhao from a level-3 to a level-4 cultivation country, with the Teng family running it and Pu Nanzi's Xuan Dao Sect ordered to help. In the present Pu Nanzi steps in to protect Teng Huayuan and survives one blow, then Lin Yi arrives and offers to spare Wang Lin for the Heaven Defying Bead. Wang Lin refuses and calls down a heavenly tribulation; Lin Yi tries to have someone die in his place, and Pu Nanzi, burning his own lifespan for the mortals of Zhao, holds him back. Wang Lin forces Teng Huayuan to name the man who found his home village, Gao Qiming of the Piao Miao Sect, and kills him; Gao Qiming then takes his own life to atone, saying he also kept one Wang bloodline safe. At his parents' grave Wang Lin declares his revenge complete, promises Situ Nan his freedom once he reaches Soul Transformation, and resolves to keep walking the path of cultivation.
